stories.title: Real-time AI <-> enterprise integration via MCP + FastAPI/SSE (Cornerstone)
stories.situation: At Cornerstone OnDemand, AI models needed a standardized, secure way to use enterprise tools and stream results back to internal systems.
stories.task: Design integration infrastructure so AI agents could call enterprise services and communicate in real time.
stories.action: Designed and built MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to expose enterprise tools to AI models, and built scalable FastAPI backends using Server-Sent Events (SSE) for low-latency streaming between agents and internal systems.
stories.result: Enabled seamless, real-time AI-agent-to-system communication on standardized, maintainable infrastructure.

stories.title: SVN + GitLab code-review agent that cut review latency (Quadeye)
stories.situation: Code review at a high-frequency trading firm spanned both SVN and GitLab and was slow and manual.
stories.task: Automate fetching, validating and managing incoming review requests/PRs across both systems.
stories.action: Built a review agent that handled the full workflow and optimized SVN handling via efficient base-checkout mechanisms to avoid redundant work.
stories.result: Automated the review pipeline and measurably improved review latency.

stories.title: Safe server-janitor service with S3 ETag verification (Quadeye)
stories.situation: Obsolete files were accumulating across many servers; naive deletion risked removing files that weren't safely backed up.
stories.task: Automatically clean obsolete files without ever deleting something not verified to exist in S3.
stories.action: Used `lfs find` for efficient file discovery and compared ETag (MD5) between disk and S3 to verify existence before any deletion.
stories.result: Reclaimed storage safely across multiple servers with a correctness guarantee against accidental data loss.

stories.title: Voice-bot quality + latency optimization (Navi)
stories.situation: Navi's customer-facing voice bot needed better response quality and lower latency.
stories.task: Improve response quality while reducing perceived latency.
stories.action: Led prompt-engineering improvements and applied latency-optimization techniques to the voice pipeline.
stories.result: Improved response quality and responsiveness of the voice bot. (Directly relevant experience to building low-latency voice agents.)

stories.title: Multimodal RAG + LoRA fine-tuning (Bosch)
stories.situation: A use case required generating image-based outputs grounded in retrieved context.
stories.task: Build multimodal RAG and adapt vision-language models to the domain.
stories.action: Engineered a multimodal RAG pipeline for image-based outputs and fine-tuned blip-2 and idefics-9b using LoRA on custom datasets with PyTorch.
stories.result: Delivered domain-adapted multimodal generation with parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

stories.title: Real-time Speech Translator (personal project)
stories.situation: Wanted seamless cross-language spoken communication in the browser.
stories.task: Build a full-stack real-time speech translator.
stories.action: Implemented WebSocket connections for real-time transport and used the Web Audio API for efficient audio capture/processing.
stories.result: Shipped a working live translator (realtime-speech-translator.netlify.app). Demonstrates hands-on real-time browser audio + streaming skills.
